Synthetic Visualforce whitespace-only id capture on a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub, 2026-11-09. Each supplied page was independently deployed with source API 59.0 and 67.0. Successful pages were rendered using PageReference.getContent in execute-anonymous and the marked element extracted; rejected rows record the deployment rejection category because detailed messages were not retained by the capture transport. Both apex outputText/outputPanel whitespace ids were rejected. Five plain HTML elements kept a one-space id, while the empty-id and nonempty-id div controls rendered without and with their respective id. The scratch org was deleted and the unique capture description matched exactly one ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
